notes.title: Launch Update 1.0.0
notes.content:
[b]Here's the list of the most important news:[/b]

-Added a new map.
-Added music preview in concert settings.
-Added message when saving.
-Added battle outro theme.
-Improved startup loading.
-Improved savable settings.
-Improved game translations.
-Version is now final release.
-Other minor fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35977945/95f1c4e701d3a78dda3e9a38dd5349632c3c1276.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.9.2
notes.content:
[b]Here's the list of the most important changes:[/b]

-Added 2 adventure stories.
-New unlockable character: Alice Belmont.
-New song: Ways To Die & HD Instrumental version.
-New song: Collapsing Dark Nebula & HD Instrumental version.
-New song: Bloodletting.
-Now selected players/AI remains between menu navigations.
-Added new game settings.
-Fixed lobby bug when pressing back immediatly after getting into the van.
-Other minor fixes.

You can give us some feedbacks under this post.
We will take every suggestion into consideration.

[b]New updates are coming very soon.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35977945/b2e1b7499d0f7184d7609174690626a264c90991.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.8
notes.content:
[i]New update patch notes:[/i]
-Improved main menu.
-Improved camera management in game.

[b]In the next updates the adventure mode will be introduced, and new characters and songs will be added.[/b]

You can leave your feedback/suggestions under this post to help us improving the game.
